error_reason: The Planner incorrectly identified the field of work of Henry Cavendish. While Cavendish did conduct his famous experiment (the Cavendish experiment) to measure the gravitational constant, his primary claim to fame and the context of the experiment is Physics (specifically mechanics and gravitation), not Chemistry. The agent failed to verify the historical context of the scientist against the specific achievement (measuring G) and incorrectly concluded the field was Chemistry. Additionally, the agent marked the task as complete with incorrect information without utilizing available search tools (WebSurfer) to verify the specific contribution.
